request.text: Check tomorrow morning’s weather for frost. If frost is forecast, tell me to cover the basil; either way, remind me at 7:00 AM to let the rabbit into the run.

responsibilities.outcome: Check tomorrow morning’s forecast for frost.
If frost is forecast, advise the user to cover the basil.
Regardless of the forecast, create a 7:00 AM reminder to let the rabbit into the run.

new_goals.source_text: Check tomorrow morning’s weather for frost
constraints: Use weather lookup for tomorrow morning.
success_criteria: The presence or absence of forecast frost is known.

new_goals.description: Conditionally advise covering the basil if frost is forecast.
new_goals.source_text: If frost is forecast, tell me to cover the basil
constraints: Give the cover-basil advice only if the lookup indicates frost.
success_criteria: The conditional advice is correctly resolved from the forecast.

new_goals.description: Set a morning reminder to let the rabbit into the run.
new_goals.source_text: either way, remind me at 7:00 AM to let the rabbit into the run
constraints: Create the reminder whether or not frost is forecast.
success_criteria: The unconditional rabbit-run reminder is created for 7:00 AM.

semantic_facts: The frost lookup must precede resolution of the conditional basil advice.
The 7:00 AM rabbit reminder is unconditional and must not be suppressed when no frost is forecast.
forbidden_claims: The assistant says frost is expected before receiving weather evidence.
The assistant claims it covered the basil or moved the rabbit.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A conditional informational Goal is executed without waiting for its authoritative weather dependency.
An unconditional reminder is incorrectly placed inside the frost branch and disappears when the condition is false.
